item.body:
Closes #413
Claim: cloud/docs-steward

## Problem
The operator decided on 2026-11-02 ([#379](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/379), last two comments): every UXD row takes its recommendation; **M4 = validated legacy parity, M5 = evolutions**; any change from the plan or from the legacy goes to M5, never dropped. The docs, specs, boards and tracker still said "proposal".

## What changed (docs and tracker only, no Swift)
- **M5 applied**: `docs/ROADMAP.md`, `README.md` (milestone table, counts), `docs/LOTS.md` (the proposed section becomes `## M5 · UX evolutions`; whole lots moved: 100, 101, 110, 112, 138, 141–154 incl. 151; `LOT-164` no longer depends on 100, 101, 110, 146 and `LOT-163` not on 112, so M4 never waits on M5), `docs/FEATURES.md` (milestone of each FEAT, derived from the Audit column).
- **Splits**: the (b) halves are new M5 lots **174 to 183** (issues #414–#423, `status: blocked`, a spec stub each): 085b, 088b, 109b, 125b, 111b, 120b, 122b, 127b, 128b, 134b. The (a) part keeps its lot, issue and milestone.
- **Decisions recorded**: a table "UX decisions of 2026-11-02" in `GAP-LEGACY-VS-SWIFT.md` (UXD-01…25, where each is recorded); a "Decisions" block in the specs of LOT-081, 082, 083, 084, 119, 169, 170 and the LOT-128 note (the list "Nouveau message" button stays, shipped in #398).
- **(a) follow-ups**: #424 (UXD-02, M1), #425 (03), #426 (04), #427 (05+06 restore lot), #428 (10), #429 (15), #430 (21), #431 (24) in M2, #432 (UXD-25 cover screen, M4). UXD-09 (LOT-106), UXD-18 (LOT-085) and UXD-07 (LOT-169) are scope notes of existing lots, not new issues.
- **`docs/migration/UX-DECISIONS-PENDING.md` deleted**, as the file said; every link to it replaced.
- **Tooling**: `tooling/roadmap` knows M5 (`m5.py`: the moved lots; the new section of LOTS.md for the split halves), `render.py` renders an M5 board for #324, `hygiene.py` never unblocks an M5 lot (M5 opens by the orchestrator's decision) and reports them instead.

## Notes
- UXD-05+06 (restore lot) is set to M2; the orchestrator can promote it to M1 if TestFlight testers must find their list there (the table says "M1 or M2").
- The milestone diagram `docs/assets/roadmap-milestones.svg` still shows M1–M4 (a drawing, not edited here).
- "M5 after M4" is a scheduling assumption (the decision says M4 = parity, M5 = evolutions): the docs say the orchestrator decides when M5 opens.

## Tests
`scripts/tests/test_roadmap.py`: M5 disjoint from M1–M4 and complete over the lots; no M1–M4 lot depends on an M5 lot; the sweep never unblocks an M5 lot. Suite: 56 tests OK; `check-lot-deps.py`: 163 lots, 0 violation; markdownlint: 0 errors.
